title: feat(studio): 概览 package overview page — Info and Pending tabs, ⋯ menu in its header
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgTC1DCWJ4MisoLdbUU1V1sb)_

Fixes #37454
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio 里打开一个软件包，左侧菜单第一行变成「概览」，有待发布的修改时旁边显示数量，点数量直接进入待发布。概览页头显示包名、「系统自带/可写」「使用中/已停用」两个标记和包的描述，下面有「信息」「待发布」两栏；原来顶栏左侧的「⋯」软件包菜单搬到了这页页头的右侧。
为什么做：这是 App Studio 改版的第一步（精简的软件包概览）。包的基本信息和等着发布的修改都集中到这一页，不用再去顶栏和设置里分头找。
出错会怎样：在 Studio 里管理软件包的人会碰到。最可能的问题是待发布数字和实际不符，或者从概览发布的结果和顶栏发布不一样；顶栏的发布按钮仍然保留，可以照常用。这个改动可以直接撤回，不涉及数据。
要你做什么：无

## What changes

- **New page `StudioPackageOverviewPage`**, reached at `/studio/PACKAGE/overview` (ADR-0084 § 概览 Overview, amendment 2026-11-26). It is drawn in an item page's frame: `StudioItemHeader` plus `StudioTab`.
  - **Header**: the app mark (or the package icon), the name, and two chips: 系统自带 with a lock on a read-only package or 可写; and 使用中 or 已停用. Both chips come from the package list row's own `writable` / `enabled`; a row that does not say draws no chip. The description is the header's note, and the ⋯ menu sits in the header's actions.
  - **信息 Info**: read-only rows for name, description, source, version and the package's app (a link that opens it). A read-only package says so beside its source. The id, namespace and type are folded under 技术信息.
  - **待发布 Pending** (`?tab=pending`): the existing `DraftChangesPanel` drawn in place. Its tab carries the pending count only while something is pending.
- **`DraftChangesPanel`** gains two optional props. Without them it behaves exactly as before; the body hunk is re-indented, so read it with `-w`.
  - `embedded` draws the same header notes and body in a `section` instead of a `Sheet`, and does not dismiss toasts on open.
  - `reloadKey` re-reads the drafts when it moves.
- **`StudioDesignSurface`**
  - Renders the overview branch with the panel wired prop for prop like the top bar's sheet: `doPublish` (or `undefined` when `publishReadOnly`), `draftScope`, `renderPublishRefusal`, the pair's `customizationOf`, and `publishing`.
  - `StudioPendingDraftsContext.Provider` now wraps the menu and pillars row, so the menu can read the count.
  - The top bar's Changes / Publish stays; ADR-0084 keeps it until a later card.
- **⋯ `StudioPackageMenu`** left `StudioBackToApp` (its `menu` prop is removed) and now lives in the overview header. Its six rows are unchanged, and it opens aligned to the end. Disable, enable and delete stay in Setup (question 1 ruled B).
- **`StudioMenu`**: the first row of a package's menu, above the groups and under no group's label, is 概览 (a package cube icon). While drafts wait it carries their count as an amber badge, a link of its own beside the row, which opens `?tab=pending`. A search lists the row when its name matches. `~org` and `~all` draw no such row. The menu reads the count from `StudioPendingDraftsContext`.
- **Address and menu model**
  - Address: `studioPackageOverviewPath` and `studioOverviewTab` in `studioAddress.ts`, with the `overview` family and the `tab=pending` row added to `studioAddressTable.ts`.
  - Menu model: `studioMenuOverviewEntry` (no entry outside a package; a badge only above zero), `studioMenuOverviewMatches`, and `studioMenuCurrentKey` answering `overview`.
- **Package REST read**: `ListedPackageManifest` now carries `enabled` and `source` from the row of `GET /api/v1/packages`. There is no `package` metadata type.
- **i18n (en, zh)**: `engine.studio.menu.overview`, `engine.studio.menu.overviewPending` and `engine.studio.overview.*`.
- **Changeset**: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

**Read first (by risk):**

1. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the overview branch's `DraftChangesPanel` props. The Pending tab must publish exactly like the top bar.
2. `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, the `embedded` return and the `reloadKey` effect deps.
3. `StudioMenu.tsx`, `renderOverview()` and its call above the groups: the badge is a sibling link, not nested in the row's link.

## Tests

The page and Pending-tab runs are on head 06830bfe76. The menu row, the merge of `origin/main` and the gates are on 618c0cf1 and ad57b709; ad57b709 only swaps the row's icon, and the menu tests and `tsc` were rerun on it.

- **New `StudioPackageOverview-37454.test.tsx`** (the real surface; the panel probe records the props given to the sheet and to the embedded panel). It covers:
  - the header chips in en and zh, read-only 系统自带 with a lock, and 已停用;
  - the menu in the header and not in the top bar, and no menu without `manage_metadata`;
  - the Info fields with the technical section folded, and the read-only source sentence;
  - the Pending count and the `?tab=pending` URL, with no count when nothing is pending;
  - embedded props identical to the sheet's, and `onPublish` undefined on both for a read-only package.
- **New `StudioMenu.overview-37454.test.tsx`** (real provider, sidebar primitive and router). It covers:
  - 概览 is the first link, above every group and under none; it opens the overview, reads 概览 in zh, and is current on the overview including the Pending tab;
  - CONTROL: `~org` and `~all` draw no row;
  - the badge reads 3 with its aria-label; CONTROL: a ledger of 0 and an unknown ledger draw no badge;
  - one click on the badge lands on `/overview?tab=pending`, and the row lands on the Info tab;
  - a search lists the row on `over` but not on `flow`.
- **`StudioMenu.test.tsx`**: the 常用 listing case now asserts that 概览 leads the menu before the 常用 types. Its #37452 cases (chevrons, active pill, graphite accent) pass unchanged.
- **Re-pointed, not weakened**: `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx` now runs every case twice, from the top bar and from the Pending tab (`describe.each`). `StudioPackageMenu-37139.test.tsx` now opens the menu from the overview header and asserts that the top bar has none.
- **Extended**: `DraftChangesPanel.posture-12517.test.tsx` covers the embedded panel: no dialog, publish with no options, no toast dismiss (control: the sheet dismisses), a `reloadKey` re-read (control: an unmoved key reads nothing more), and nothing drawn when closed. `studioMenuModel.test.ts` covers the overview entry, the badge, the matcher and the current key. `studioAddress.test.ts` covers the builder, the tab and the table lists.
- **Broad run** over `studio-design/`, `preview/` and `packages/i18n/` on 618c0cf1: 449 files, 4714 passed and 13 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The two menu test files on ad57b709: 45 passed.
- **Typecheck**: app-shell `tsc --noEmit` exits 0 on ad57b709 and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 0 on 618c0cf1.
- **Ablation** (each leg went red, and each restore is proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty):
  - A1: Pending tab `onPublish` set to undefined. 6 red: 5 Pending-tab publish cases and the prop-parity case.
  - A2: embedded panel dismisses toasts. 1 red.
  - A3: `reloadKey` dropped from the effect deps. 1 red.
  - A4: `embedded` branch disabled. 1 red.
  - A5: read-only chip forced off. 3 red.
  - A6: badge drawn at zero in the model. 1 red.
  - B1: the menu row moved below the groups. 1 red (the first-row pin).
  - B2: the badge drawn whatever the count. 2 red (the zero and unknown controls).
  - B3: the badge linked to the row's own address. 1 red (the badge-click pin).

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's file surface was amended to add `StudioMenu.tsx` for the 概览 row and its badge only. `studio-tokens.ts`, `studioAccent.ts`, `studioTitleRow.tsx` and `PageShell.tsx` are untouched.
- The row is drawn in `StudioMenu.tsx` and not through `buildStudioMenu`, which builds only the domain groups: adding a kind there would change the per-kind records the menu keys on. The row reuses the sidebar primitive's `SidebarMenuButton`, so its active state is the same graphite pill as every entry. In the real browser the current-row background reads `rgba(53, 57, 64, 0.1)` in light and `rgba(208, 210, 216, 0.18)` in dark, the same on the 流程 entry and on the 概览 row, and the 5 group chevrons are drawn.
- The icon is a package cube (`Package`). A first cut used `LayoutDashboard`, which the browser showed to be indistinguishable from 应用's `LayoutGrid`.
- **Mockup 4 comparison.**
  - Header, chips, description, tabs, the Info card and the folded 技术信息 match.
  - Not in this card's governing text: the standalone 导出 button (export stays a ⋯ row, six rows unchanged) and the 发布历史 tab.
  - The source line shows the row's own `source` (代码。只读：不能直接修改。). The mockup's pair-aware sentence (你的修改会单独保存…) is copy for a later pass.
- `STUDIO_OVERVIEW_TAB_PARAM` lives in `studioAddress.ts` beside the builder that writes it, following ui AGENTS rule #8 on `?tab=` constants. The address table registers it with `keptOnRetiredInterfaces: false`.
- `reloadKey` is a prop added to the load effect's deps and not a `key=` bump, following ui AGENTS rule #8 on forced reloads.
- The top-bar Publish is unchanged and stays until the card ADR-0084 names for its removal.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run the showcase example and open `/studio/com.example.showcase/overview`. Expect:
- the header with ObjectStack Showcase, 系统自带 with a lock, 使用中 and the description, with ⋯ at the right;
- 信息 with 基本信息 and a folded 技术信息;
- 待发布 listing any drafts, with 全部发布 at the bottom.

**Real browser**: Chromium at deviceScaleFactor 2, light and dark, on the showcase with 3 AI-style view drafts in its customization pair.
- Shots taken: the Info tab, the Info tab with 技术信息 open, the ⋯ menu open with its six rows, the Pending tab with a count of 3, the Pending tab after publishing, the menu with 概览 first and its badge (full page and close-up), and a badge click landing on the Pending tab.
- In the menu, the first links are 概览, its badge (3, `3 项修改待发布`), then 对象. Clicking the badge lands on `/studio/com.example.showcase/overview?tab=pending` with the Pending tab open and 概览 current.
- Clicking 全部发布 in the Pending tab sent `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase.custom/publish-drafts`. `_drafts` then read empty and the tab count disappeared.
